title: Sikky Nissan Z33/Infiniti G35 LS1 Master Cylinder Adapter Kit
description:
A simple solution for clutch hydraulics on the LS1 swapped 350Z.  This bolt on kit will take all the headaches out of bleeding your T56 clutch system.  Everything needed is included.



Features:



CAD/CAM designed CNC billet aluminum adapter plate

Wilwood 7/8″ master cylinder

All needed stainless braided lines

Sikky adapter fitting that threads into factory GM slave cylinder without modification

Bleeder line and custom bracket

All needed hardware and fittings
